title: Step 4: after one failed chat reply, a '…' stays forever and every later message fails too
where: /admin/new, SessionBuilder (src/app/admin/session-builder.tsx), chat error state; from code, not seen
what_happens: From code, not seen (an error can't be forced on production without breaking something). When a reply fails, the empty reply bubble stays as a grey '…' that looks like it's still thinking, under 'Something went wrong. Try again.'. Trying again sends that empty assistant message back to the model; toApiMessages (src/lib/session-builder.ts) turns it into an assistant turn with no content, which the Anthropic API rejects, so every retry fails the same way and adds another '…'. Only a reload clears it (loadSaved drops empty replies).
who_hurts: An admin building a session with the chat: one hiccup (timeout, model overload) and the chat looks stuck and keeps failing; they don't know a reload fixes it and may give up on the chat.
suggested_fix: In the catch in session-builder.tsx send(), drop the empty last assistant message (setMessages(prev => prev.at(-1)?.content || prev.at(-1)?.draft ? prev : prev.slice(0,-1))), and put the user's text back in the input. Optionally skip empty assistant turns in toApiMessages too.
rule: general: error state must let you retry
step: 4: describe the session in the chat
